about: Made-up mentions of @truecfb for testing the reply bot's model step (src/reply_eval.py). Each has what a person reading it would expect: the intent, the teams, the conferences and the season ('current' or a year). Not real posts. Includes questions about how the formula works and why a team sits where it does, for the model-written replies (reply_writer.py).
